basic_info.description: Perched atop Leavenworth Street, this impeccably remodeled condo blends quintessential San Francisco charm with modern luxury in the heart of Russian Hill. Just steps to North Beach and Polk St, this stylish and sophisticated residence offers the ultimate city living.  Inside, you'll find a custom-designed chef's kitchenfeaturing dual wine fridges, a large Liebherr double refrigerator, a walk-in pantry +  sleek new appliances and fixtures throughout. The kitchen overlooks a lush, private hillside garden and flows seamlessly into the elegant dining and living rooms, complete with bay views, built-in shelving, chic wallpaper, and high ceilings.  The home offers two bedrooms and two beautifully renovated bathrooms, including a luxurious primary suite with more bay views, a walk-in closet with custom built-ins, and a spa-inspired en-suite bath featuring a double vanity, walk-in shower, and soaking tub.  Enjoy the shared rooftop deck boasting panoramic views of the bay and city skyline. Additional highlights include an in-unit washer/dryer, shared garden, and one-car garage parking with secure interior access.  Enjoy the best of Russian Hilljust around the corner Hyde St, Frascati Restaurant, 7 Hills, Swenson's Ice-cream, iconic crooked Lombard St, and gorgeous Francisco Park.
